Finance (summary)

Profit per project in the deal owner: sale − costs (purchase + work + sale) − overhead = profit. For cash, the tab Cash Flow; for the consolidated, the DRE.

🏢 Overhead allocated per project
Overhead = rate × base of each project · the company fixed cost allocated, which reduces net profit.
